items.title: Frankfurt am Main
items.summary: Explore Frankfurt, a large German city that offers a different experience compared to Berlin or Munich, with its unique urban landscape.

items.title: Backfischfest (City Festival)
items.summary: Attend the largest wine and folk festival on the Rhine in Worms, featuring nine days of activities, the Worms Fishermen’s Guild, and a lively atmosphere for all.

items.title: Deidesheimer Weinkerwe
items.summary: Visit this special wine festival where wineries open their courtyards and Bahnhofstraße becomes the 'Woigass' with wine, regional specialties, music, and rides for families.

items.title: Kerwe (Village Fest)
items.summary: Experience traditional village festivals with various dates and locations in the KMC, offering local culture and community gatherings. Check local listings for specific town details.

items.title: Street Food & Music Festival
items.summary: Enjoy international street food from over 20 food trucks, live music from bands and DJs, and refreshing drinks at Messeplatz in Kaiserslautern. Free entry for all food and music lovers.

items.title: Atlantic Wall Museum Noordwijk
items.summary: Explore a unique piece of European history at this WWII defense structure in the Netherlands, featuring preserved bunkers, reconstructed interiors, and an underground tunnel system.

items.title: Adventures Begin Here – End of Summer Fest
items.summary: Enjoy live entertainment, contests, food trucks, and family activities at Pulaski Park. This event highlights Outdoor Recreation programs and includes a drawing for a 2026 MINI Cooper S.

items.title: Baumholder Library Programs
items.summary: The Baumholder Library offers a variety of programs for all ages, including different storytimes, Makermania, Lego Club, and Family Film Fest, returning in September.

items.title: Kaiserslautern’s End of Summer Car Show
items.summary: Military-affiliated ID card holders can register their vehicles for judging in categories like Best European and Best Muscle Car, with prizes awarded. Pulaski Auto Skills will also be open.

items.title: Latin Nights at the Rheinlander!
items.summary: Enjoy live Latin music from The Salsa Band Borinkuba, featuring Salsa, Merengue, and Bachata. Food is available, and there's no cover charge for this 18+ event.
items.dateHint: Last Friday of the month, 9 p.m. to 1 a.m.

items.title: Stufffed Animal Sleepover
items.summary: Kids can check their stuffed animals into the 'Fuzzy Arms Hotel' at the Baumholder Library for a weekend of fun and mischief, with photos and notes provided upon checkout.

items.title: Frankfurt City Forest
items.summary: Discover an absolutely massive forest near Frankfurt, featuring over 400 kilometers of trails perfect for jogging, hiking, cycling, or skipping, all for free.

items.title: Frankfurt Zoo
items.summary: Visit a world-class zoo in Frankfurt, known for its excellent animal care and beautiful design. It's a large zoo, open daily, and booking tickets in advance is recommended.

items.title: Main River
items.summary: Experience the heart of Frankfurt by walking along the wide paths and parks flanking the Main river. Enjoy incredible skyline views, especially at night.

items.title: Palmengarten
items.summary: Explore Frankfurt's Botanical Garden, offering year-round beauty with an indoor tropical garden, bamboo grove, and play areas for children. A great spot for the whole family.

items.title: Römerberg
items.summary: Wander through Frankfurt's historic center, the picturesque Römerberg square, with its colorful half-timbered buildings and the Römer city hall. Great for families to explore on foot.
